title: The legend of Shunahshepa, continued
introduction: Sage Vishvamitra curses his sons as they defy his orders and accords two esoteric hymns to Shunashepa, for chanting them in the Vedic-ritual of Ambariisha. Shunashepa gets longevity on chanting those hymns. Thus Vishvamitra not only creates another universe as in Trishanku's episode, he even accords longevity, or even deathlessness to mortals by his ascetic power. Such as he is, he is the mentor of Rama, and hence Sage Shataananda informs Rama about the capabilities of his own mentor, Vishvamitra, in these many episodes.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्विषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 62nd chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
शुनःशेपं नरश्रेष्ठ गृहीत्वा तु महायशाः |
व्यश्रामत् पुष्करे राजा मध्याह्ने रघुनंदन
verses.iast:
śunaḥśepam naraśreṣṭha gṛhītvā tu mahāyaśāḥ |
vyaśrāmat puṣkare rājā madhyāhne raghunandana
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the best one among men and the legatee of Raghu, on taking Shunashepa that highly renowned king Ambariisha took rest at noontime on the lakeside of Holy Lake." Thus Sage Shataananda continued the legend of Shunashepa, as a part of Vishvamitra's legend.

glosses.meaning: highly renowned one, that king Ambariisha

verses.devanagari:
तस्य विश्रममाणस्य शुनःशेपो महायशाः |
पुष्करं ज्येष्ठमागम्य विश्वामित्रं ददर्श ह
तप्यन्तमृषिभिः सार्धं मातुलं परमातुरः |
verses.iast:
tasya viśramamāṇasya śunaḥśepo mahāyaśāḥ |
puṣkaram jyeṣṭham āgaṃya viśvāmitram dadarśa ha
tapyantam ṛṣibhiḥ sārtham mātulam parama āturaḥ |
verses.translation: "While the king Ambariisha is taking rest that highly brilliant Shunashepa came to the lakeside of main Holy Lake with high anxiety, and there he indeed saw his maternal uncle Sage Vishvamitra who is performing ascesis along with other sages.

glosses.meaning: elder [main one,] holy lakeside, having come
maternal uncle, at Vishvamitra, he [Shunashepa] saw, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
विषण्णवदनो दीनस्तृष्णया च श्रमेण च
पपाताङ्के मुने राम वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह |
verses.iast:
viṣaṇṇa vadano dīnaḥ tṛṣṇayā ca śrameṇa ca
papāta anke mune rāma vākyam ca idam uvāca ha |
verses.translation: "Shunashepa became pitiable and sulky faced by strain and thirst, oh, Rama, and he immediately fell in the lap of saint Vishvamitra saying this sentence.

glosses.meaning: by thirst, also, by strain, also
in saint Vishvamitra's, in flank [lap,] fell down

verses.devanagari:
न मेऽस्ति माता न पिता ज्ञातयो बान्धवाः कुतः
त्रातुमर्हसि मां सौम्य धर्मेण मुनिपुंगव |
verses.iast:
na me asti mātā na pitā jñātayo bāndhavāḥ kutaḥ
trātum ar.hhasi mām sauṃya dharmeṇa munipuṅgava |
verses.translation: " 'I have no mother or a father to save me. Then wherefore cousins or relatives will be there to protect me. Oh, peaceable saint the eminent, it will be apt of you to protect me according to saintliness.

glosses.meaning: to me, mother, not, is there
me, according to saintliness, to protect, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
त्राता त्वं हि नरश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषां त्वं हि भावनः
राजा च कृतकार्यः स्यादहं दीर्घायुरव्ययः |
स्वर्गलोकमुपाश्नीयां तपस्तप्त्वा ह्यनुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
trātā tvam hi naraśreṣṭha sarveṣām tvam hi bhāvanaḥ
rājā ca kṛtakāryaḥ syāt aham dīrgha āyuḥ avyayaḥ |
svarga lokam upāśnīyām tapaḥ taptvā hi anuttamam
verses.translation: " 'Oh, illustrious sage, you alone are the saviour to each and every one, isn't it! You alone are the guardian angel, isn't it! Hence, let the purpose of the king Ambariisha be achieved, and let longevity come to me, and I on becoming imperishable and indeed on performing an unexcelled ascesis, I wish to enjoy in heavenly worlds.

glosses.meaning: oh, best one among men - illustrious sage
you are, to each and every one, saviour, isn't it
you are, apologist - upholder - guardian angel, isn't it
king Ambariisha, also, achieved, [of his] purpose, let him be
un, excelled, ascesis, on performing, indeed
heavenly, worlds, I wish to enjoy.

verses.devanagari:
स मे नाथो ह्यनाथस्य भव भव्येन चेतसा |
पितेव पुत्रं धर्मात्मंस्त्रातुमर्हसि किल्बिषात्
verses.iast:
sa me nātho hi anāthasya bhava bhavyena cetasā |
pitā iva putram dharmāatman trātum ar.hhasi kilbiṣāt
verses.translation: " You shall be my providence with a providential sentiment as I stand unprotected, and oh, virtue souled one, it will be apt of you to protect me from misfortune, like a father protecting his own son.' Thus Shunashepa appealed to Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: from misfortune, to protect, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रो महातपाः |
सान्त्वयित्वा बहुविधं पुत्रानिदमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
tasya tat vacanam śrutvā viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ |
sāntvayitvā bahu vidham putrān idam uvāca ha
verses.translation: "On hearing that sentence of Shunashepa and on pacifying him in many ways, Vishvamitra of higher ascesis, indeed said this to his sons.

glosses.meaning: his [of Shunashepa,] that, sentence, on hearing
in many, a way, having pacified

verses.devanagari:
यत्कृते पितरः पुत्रान् जनयन्ति शुभार्थिनः |
परलोकहितार्थाय तस्य कालोऽयमागतः
verses.iast:
yat kṛte pitaraḥ putrān janayanti śubha arthinaḥ |
para loka hita arthāya tasya kālo ayam āgataḥ
verses.translation: " 'For what reason parents engender sons, desiring positivity and for the purpose of welfare in the other worlds, this is the time that has come for fulfilling that reason.
notes: Vividly: 'A father's ambition in begetting sons is to do something good and positive to the society in the present world and when departed a right place is acquired in heavens through these sons, by their yearly death-day rituals etc., and hence you do some good in saving this boy from premature death and earn an apt place for me in heavens...'

glosses.meaning: in other, world, welfare, for the purpose of

verses.devanagari:
अयं मुनिसुतो बालो मत्तः शरणमिच्छति |
अस्य जीवितमात्रेण प्रियं कुरुत पुत्रकाः
verses.iast:
ayam muni suto bālo mattaḥ śaraṇam icchati |
asya jīvita mātreṇa priyam kuruta putrakāḥ
verses.translation: " 'This youngster is the son of sage and he aspires shelter from me. Hence, oh, sons, give him satisfaction just by giving life to him.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वे सुकृतकर्माणः सर्वे धर्मपरायणाः |
पशुभूता नरेन्द्रस्य तृप्तिमग्नेः प्रयच्छत
verses.iast:
sarve sukṛta karmāṇaḥ sarve dharma parāyaṇāḥ |
paśu bhūtā narendrasya tṛptim agneḥ prayacchata
verses.translation: " 'You all have done very good pious deeds and you all abide by probity. Hence, you bestow appeasement to Fire-god on your becoming the ritual-animals of king Ambariisha in lieu of this boy Shunashepa.

glosses.meaning: you all, in probity, have abidance

verses.devanagari:
नाथनान् च शुनःशेपो यज्ञश्चाविघ्नतो भवेत् |
देवतास्तर्पिताश्च स्युर्मम चापि कृतं वचः
verses.iast:
nāthanān ca śunaḥśepo yajñaḥ ca avighnato bhavet |
devatāḥ tarpitāḥ ca syuḥ mama ca api kṛtam vacaḥ
verses.translation: " 'As a result, Shunashepa will have protectors, Vedic-ritual will be unimpeded, gods will be oblated, and my word too will be actualised.' Thus Vishvamitra said to his sons.

glosses.meaning: Shunashepa will be, with protectors, also
Vedic-ritual, also, un, impeded, it will become
gods, oblated, also, they will be

verses.devanagari:
मुनेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा मधुष्यन्दादयः सुताः |
साभिमानं नरश्रेष्ठ सलीलमिदमब्रुवन्
verses.iast:
muneḥ tu vacanam śrutvā madhuṣyanda ādayaḥ sutāḥ |
sa abhimānam naraśreṣṭha sa līlam idam abruvan
verses.translation: "But on hearing the saying of the sage, oh, Rama, the best of men, Madhushyanda and the other sons of Vishvamitra said this, haughtily and disparagingly.

glosses.meaning: Madhu syanda, and other, sons - of Vishvamitra, on their part

verses.devanagari:
कथमात्मसुतान् हित्वा त्रायसेऽन्यसुतं विभो |
अकार्यमिव पश्यामः श्वमांसमिव भोजने
verses.iast:
katham ātma sutān hitvā trāyase anya sutam vibho |
akāryam iva paśyāmaḥ śva māṃsam iva bhojane
verses.translation: " 'On sacrificing your own sons how can you save another's son, oh, lordly father, we deem this as a wrongdoing and as good as dog's meat in a dinner.' Thus the sons of Vishvamitra replied their father.
notes: Vishvamitra will be nagged by almost all, including his sons, on this 'dog-meat-eating.' There is a parable in Maha Bharata that Vishvamitra once tried to eat dog's meat when he did not get any food, but caught red-handedly. Later this has become the curse-theme to Vishvamitra when he cursed Vashishta's sons. At the present juncture also he curses his own sons with the same theme.

glosses.meaning: your own, sons, on leaving off [sacrificing]
in dinner, dog's, meat, as [good as]

verses.devanagari:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पुत्राणां मुनिपुंगवः |
क्रोधसंरक्तनयनो व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā putrāṇām munipuṅgavaḥ |
krodha saṃrakta nayano vyāhartum upacakrame
verses.translation: "On listening that saying of his sons that eminent sage Vishvamitra started to curse them while fury reddened his eyes.

glosses.meaning: their, of sons, that, saying, on listening

verses.devanagari:
निःसाध्वसमिदं प्रोक्तं धर्मादपि विगर्हितम् |
अतिक्रम्य तु मद्वाक्यं दारुणं रोमहर्षणम्
verses.iast:
niḥsādhvasam idam proktam dharmāt api vigarhitam |
atikraṃya tu mat vākyam dāruṇam roma harṣaṇam
verses.translation: " 'You all have not only transgressed my word, but pertly replied me in an impudent manner which is abhorrent and hair-raising, and recriminatory according to probity.

glosses.meaning: my, word, [you all] on over, stepping - on transgressing

verses.devanagari:
श्वमांसभोजिनः सर्वे वासिष्ठा इव जातिषु |
पूर्णं वर्षसहस्रं तु पृथिव्यामनुवत्स्यथ
verses.iast:
śva māṃsa bhojinaḥ sarve vāsiṣṭhā iva jātiṣu |
pūrṇam varṣa sahasram tu pṛthivyām anuvatsyatha
verses.translation: " 'You all will be whirling around the earth totally for a thousand years taking birth in the race that subsists on dog's meat, like the sons of Vashishta.' Thus Vishvamitra cursed his sons.

verses.devanagari:
कृत्वा शापसमायुक्तान् पुत्रान् मुनिवरस्तदा |
शुनःशेपमुवाचार्थं कृत्वा रक्षां निरामयाम्
verses.iast:
kṛtvā śāpa samāyuktān putrān munivaraḥ tadā |
śunaḥśepam uvāca ārtam kṛtvā rakṣām nirāmayām
verses.translation: "On making his sons bounden by curse, then that best saint spoke to the pitiable Shunashepa, on making unharmed invulnerability to him with sanctifying hymns.

verses.devanagari:
पवित्रपाशैर्बद्धो रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनः |
वैष्णवं यूपमासाद्य वाग्भिरग्निमुदाहर
verses.iast:
pavitra pāśair baddho rakta mālya anulepanaḥ |
vaiṣṇavam yūpam āsādya vāgbhiḥ agnim udāhara
verses.translation: " 'When you are fastened with sacred fastener to the sacrificial post of Vishnu, smeared with red paste and garlanded with red garlands, you praisefully address the Fire-god with the words I going to impart to you in Vedic hymns.

glosses.meaning: Vishnu's, sacrificial post, on attaining [when you are fastened]
with red, garlands, smeared with [red] paste
with word [with hymns I am going to tell]
to Fire-god, you address [you praise him.]

verses.devanagari:
इमे च गाथे द्वे दिव्ये गायेथा मुनिपुत्रक |
अंबरीषस्य यज्ञेऽस्मिंस्ततः सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि
verses.iast:
ime ca gāthe dve divye gāyethā muni putraka |
ambarīṣasya yajñe asmin tataḥ siddhim avāpsyasi
verses.translation: " 'These two divine hymns, oh, son of saint, shall be chanted in the Vedic-ritual of Ambariisha, then you will obtain your aspiration.' Thus Vishvamitra taught two Vedic hymns to the boy.

glosses.meaning: in of Ambariisha, in that, Vedic-ritual

verses.devanagari:
शुनःशेपो गृहीत्वा ते द्वे गाथे सुसमाहितः |
त्वरया राजसिंहं तमंबरीषमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
śunaḥśepo gṛhītvā te dve gāthe susamāhitaḥ |
tvarayā rāja siṃham tam ambarīṣam uvāca ha
verses.translation: "Shunashepa having taken those two hymns from Vishvamitra very attentively has instantly gone to that lion-king Ambariisha and indeed spoke to him.

verses.devanagari:
राजसिंह महाबुद्धे शीघ्रं गच्छावहे वयम् |
निवर्तयस्व राजेन्द्र दीक्षां च समुदाहर
verses.iast:
rāja siṃha mahābuddhe śīghram gacchāvahe vayam |
nivartayasva rājendra dīkṣām ca samudāhara
verses.translation: " 'Oh, king the lion, let us go promptly to your ritual place, oh, best king, you may apply yourself to your pledge in completing the ritual, with me as its sacrificial animal,' thus the boy said.

verses.devanagari:
तद्वाक्यमृषिपुत्रस्य श्रुत्वा हर्षसमन्वितः |
जगाम नृपतिः शीघ्रं यज्ञवाटमतन्द्रितः
verses.iast:
tat vākyam ṛṣi putrasya śrutvā harṣa samanvitaḥ |
jagāma nṛpatiḥ śīghram yajña vāṭam atandritaḥ
verses.translation: "On listening that sentence of the son of sage, the king Ambariisha is gladdened and proceeded to the ritual hall immediately and spiritedly.

glosses.meaning: of sage, son's, that, sentence, on listening

verses.devanagari:
सदस्यानुमते राजा पवित्रकृतलक्षणम् |
पशुं रक्ताम्बरं कृत्वा यूपे तं समबन्धयत्
verses.iast:
sadasya anumate rājā pavitra kṛta lakṣaṇam |
paśum rakta ambaram kṛtvā yūpe tam samabandhayat
verses.translation: "The king with the permission of officiators of ritual got the boy prepared as a ritual animal with sanctified bodily features and clad him in red clothes and got him securely fastened to the sacrificial post.

glosses.meaning: sanctity, prepared, with features [got the boy is prepared with bodily features of sanctity]
with red, cloth, as ritual animal

verses.devanagari:
स बद्धो वाग्भिरग्र्याभिरभितुष्टाव वै सुरौ |
इन्द्रमिन्द्रानुजं चैव यथावन्मुनिपुत्रकः
verses.iast:
sa baddho vāgbhiḥ agryābhiḥ abhituṣṭāva vai surau |
indram indra anujam caiva yathāvat muni putrakaḥ
verses.translation: "When Shunashepa is tied to ritual post he immensely pleased two gods, namely Indra and Upendra as well, with those two hymns he got from Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: when tied, he, saint's, son - Shunashepa

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रीतः सहस्राक्षो रहस्यस्तुतितोषितः |
दीर्घमायुस्तदा प्रादाच्छुनःशेपाय राघव
verses.iast:
tataḥ prītaḥ sahasra akṣo rahasya stuti toṣitaḥ |
dīrgham āyuḥ tadā prādāt śunaḥśepāya rāghava
verses.translation: "Then the Thousand-eyed Indra who is satisfied with esoteric laudation is gladdened, and oh, Raghava, then he bestowed longevity to Shunashepa.

glosses.meaning: esoteric, by laudation, who is satisfied

verses.devanagari:
स च राजा नरश्रेष्ठ यज्ञस्य च समाप्तवान् |
फलं बहुगुणं राम सहस्राक्षप्रसादजम्
verses.iast:
sa ca rājā naraśreṣṭha yajñasya ca samāptavān |
phalam bahu guṇam rāma sahasrākṣa prasādajam
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the best one among men, he that king Ambariisha also obtained the fruits of that Vedic-ritual in manyfold, resulted from the grace of Thousand-eyed Indra.

glosses.meaning: oh, best one among men, Rama
Vedic-ritual, fruits of, also, well, obtained.

verses.devanagari:
विश्वामित्रोऽपि धर्मात्मा भूयस्तेपे महातपाः |
पुष्करेषु नरश्रेष्ठ दशवर्षशतानि च
verses.iast:
viśvāmitro api dharmātmā bhūyaḥ tepe mahātapāḥ |
puṣkareṣu naraśreṣṭha daśa varṣa śatāni ca
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the best among men, even the virtue-souled great ascetic Vishvamitra again performed ascesis at the same Holy lakeside for another thousand years." Thus Sage Shataananda continued the narration of Vishvamitra's legend.

glosses.meaning: oh, best one among men Rama
